why: Errors from the apiserver talking to etcd (timeout, leader changed, too many requests). Managed, so not fixable, but the impact is real
query: fields @timestamp, @message | filter @logStream like /kube-apiserver-/ and (@message like /etcdserver/ or @message like /etcd.*timed out/ or @message like /leader changed/) | stats count() as c by bin(1h) | sort @timestamp desc
